title: pretending it's fall in the middle of summer 🎃 SUMMERWEEN cozy vlog
description:
welcome to my ultimate SUMMERWEEN vlog 🎃🌻
today we're pretending it's fall (in the middle of summer) by shopping for all things fall, finding spooky season goodies, doing a summerween haul, baking pumpkin bread, making a veggie pot pie, taking a cozy self-care shower, and ending the day with a movie night (watching obsession)! 

if you love cozy vlogs, fall, halloween, shopping, baking, and romanticizing everyday life, I hope this vlog gives you a little summerween inspiration!
